194e5e125609518c.subject: Your Saturday Daily Dad Review — Week of February 3 - 9
194e5e125609518c.body:
​

​
​

--------------------
PASSAGE OF THE WEEK:
--------------------

You have softened a little—in all the ways. You have a new
perspective on your career. And yes, sometimes being a parent is
boring, but as the Gang of Youths song reminds us, “It's boring
but in the most exquisite of ways.”
Read: This is What Completeness Comes From (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/g3hnh5h3v6eo47sr/aHR0cHM6Ly9kYWlseWRhZC5jb20vdGhpcy1pcy13aGF0LWNvbXBsZXRlbmVzcy1jb21lcy1mcm9tLw==
)​

-----------------------------
YOUTUBE TAKEAWAY OF THE WEEK:
-----------------------------

​ (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/3ohphkh7w4q9e2cr/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_YWJfY2hhbm5lbD1EYWlseURhZCZ2PW9TbEprOFNBcUd3
)Over on the Daily Dad YouTube Channel (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/48hvhehro60q4qux/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vQERhaWx5RGFkWVQ=
), Ryan Holiday and actor Matthew McConaughey discuss being a
“brother” to your kids and the importance of letting them fail:

“I thought it was the parent fully sculpting [their kids]. No,
you’re nudging….You want them to get a few bruises, you don’t
want to take away all the thicket in the broken glass, but you
also don’t want them to break their leg every time they go out
the door.”
-->Watch the full video here: Matthew McConaughey’s Powerful
Parenting Lessons (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/reh8hoh08wqvg5s2/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1vU2xKazhTQXFHdw==
)
Watch the full video here: Matthew McConaughey’s Powerful
Parenting Lessons ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oSlJk8SAqGw )

-----------------------------
PODCAST TAKEAWAY OF THE WEEK:
-----------------------------

(
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/08hwh9hd8gmw3mul/aHR0cHM6Ly9wb2RjYXN0cy5hcHBsZS5jb20vdXMvcG9kY2FzdC9saXZpbmctd2l0aC1hLXN0b2ljLXJ5YW4tYW5kLXNhbS1ob2xpZGF5L2lkMTQ5MDAwNzQ4Nz9pPTEwMDA2ODc3OTIwMjQ=
)​
On a new episode of The Daily Dad Podcast (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/vqh3hrhp5en3zofg/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYnV6enNwcm91dC5jb20vNDI0MjYx
), Ryan Holiday speaks with his wife Sam on life in their early
20s, how parenting philosophies change over time, and
transitioning from one to two kids:

“With our first child, we had no idea what we were doing. And
with the second child, it’s two kids—obviously it’s doing
something more, it’s much more stressful in a lot of ways. But
for me, I had a lot more confidence because this isn’t the first
time that I’m experiencing most of these things. Knowing that I
have knowledge to fall back on is comforting.”
-->Listen to the full episode: Living With a Stoic | Ryan and Sam
Holiday (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/08hwh9hd8gmw3mul/aHR0cHM6Ly9wb2RjYXN0cy5hcHBsZS5jb20vdXMvcG9kY2FzdC9saXZpbmctd2l0aC1hLXN0b2ljLXJ5YW4tYW5kLXNhbS1ob2xpZGF5L2lkMTQ5MDAwNzQ4Nz9pPTEwMDA2ODc3OTIwMjQ=
)
Listen to the full episode: Living With a Stoic | Ryan and Sam
Holiday (
https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/living-with-a-stoic-ryan-and-sam-holiday/id1490007487?i=1000687792024
)Subscribe to Daily Dad Podcast

​ (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/dpheh0h038qwlrfm/aHR0cHM6Ly9wb2RjYXN0cy5hcHBsZS5jb20vdXMvcG9kY2FzdC90aGUtZGFpbHktZGFkL2lkMTQ5MDAwNzQ4Nw==
)

-----------------------------
WHAT RYAN HOLIDAY IS READING:
-----------------------------

“It is, after all, not necessary to fly right into the middle of
the sun, but it is necessary to crawl to a clean little spot on
Earth where the sun sometimes shines and one can warm oneself a
little.”
— Letter to the Father (
https://click.convertkit-mail2.com/o8u2pkxdxgtqh6k0367bquqlemrrrso/7qh7h8hogw0prqiz/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGhlcGFpbnRlZHBvcmNoLmNvbS9jb2xsZWN0aW9ucy8xNS1ib29rcy10aGF0LXdpbGwtbWFrZS15b3UtYS1iZXR0ZXItcGFyZW50L3Byb2R1Y3RzL2xldHRlci10by10aGUtZmF0aGVyLWJyaWVmLWFuLWRlbi12YXRlci1iaWxpbmd1YWwtZWRpdGlvbi10aGUtc2Nob2NrZW4ta2Fma2EtbGlicmFyeQ==
